title: narcissus blancoi
intro: Narcissus blancoi, commonly known as the white daffodil or baker's daffodil, is a plant species in the Amaryllidaceae family. The health benefits of Narcissus blancoi include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, which can help alleviate conditions such as epilepsy, arthritis, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant involve its ability to exhibit sedative, anxiolytic, and analgesic effects, making it useful in treating anxiety, insomnia, and pain management. Bioactive constituents of Narcissus blancoi include galantamine, lycorine, and other alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
